entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order. I need to make a return for a jersey I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Alex. I see the ProFit Jersey here, delivered on October 6th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. I ordered it for a race that got postponed, and I just tried it on for the first time. It's the wrong size for me, just a bit too tight across the shoulders.
I understand. So it's a sizing issue. And you're looking to return it, not necessarily exchange it?
Well, I'd consider an exchange for a larger size, but a return would be fine too. Whatever is easier based on how long it's been.

Okay, let me just pull up our current return policy. One moment... Okay, thank you for waiting. I've checked the policy for this item. Since your jersey was delivered within the last 90 days, you are eligible for a full refund. I can go ahead and email you a pre-paid return label right now.
Oh, that's fantastic. I wasn't sure if it would still be possible. Thank you for making that so easy.
You're very welcome. The email is on its way to the address on file. Just print the label, attach it to the package, and drop it at any post office.

Great. Just one more quick question. Since I will be ordering the correct size and there was some inconvenience with the fit, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Even 10% would be appreciated.

I appreciate you asking, Alex. While I can't provide a discount code, I am happy we were able to approve the full refund for your return. Once the warehouse receives the original jersey, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Fair enough, I had to ask. Approving the return is a big help. Thanks again for your assistance, Isaac.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
